facts.business: Diamines and Chemicals Limited is engaged in the manufacturing of Speciality Chemicals and Trading in Fruits and Vegetables.
key_risks: Litigations and claims pending with multiple tax authorities (Income Tax, Excise/Service Tax, Provident Fund) involving significant amounts and management judgment
Recognition of Expected Credit Loss (ECL) on Trade Receivables of Trading Division
Write down of inventories at Net Realizable Value (NRV)
Lower raw material consumption and purchases
Higher capital employed following share issuance
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with related parties include remuneration to KMPs (Amit M Mehta: Rs 24.00 Lakhs, Tanmay Godiawala: Rs 36.77 Lakhs), sitting fees to directors, professional fees to R.S.Chhabra & Co. (Rs 12.00 Lakhs), and commission to directors (previous year). Entities over which KMPs exercise significant influence include S Amit & Co., S Amit Speciality Chemicals Pvt.
